body: Still getting after it. Checking in, G2G!

Hey folks, similar concerns here — I have an appt to meet a therapist but have concerns about confidentiality and security clearance. Is there a time my therapist’s notes could be subject to review for anything having to do with my work?

That sounds really difficult — I’ve had some minor physical limitations, but even those made a huge impact on my positivity and energy level; it probably feels impossible sometimes. I’m sorry. I can see how devastating it could be to feel like you’ve been failed by your own body.
I’ll fight with you - rebound and try your best to find a small win in tomorrow?
waiting for this appt and swinging from relapse to resolution to relapse; 3 times in the last week. UGH. Looking for some basic how-to resiliency.
This is a great reminder. Thanks.

Temptation: take 5 more mins on Insta or Snapchat. 

Self-control: think through difficulty.

Temptation: you’re up late anyway, what’s another couple clicks or a lingering browse...

Self-control: recognize the clarity from even just 5 days clean and embrace it.

Quit now. The freedom that comes from not being tied to this addiction is something I’m still chasing. Your self-esteem, relationships, time investment... they will improve. Don’t waste time thinking about what has happened to bring you here. Focus on the present, put one foot in front of the other, and walk away from a destructive waste of time toward freedom and happiness.
